title: Secure wishlist.ts and goals.ts
description: Apply the same ctx.auth pattern to wishlist.ts and goals.ts. Remove all visitorId arguments.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Import getAuthUserId, requireAuth from authHelpers in both files
userWishlist: Remove visitorId from all args
userWishlist: Use by_user index for all queries
userGoals: Remove visitorId from all args
userGoals: Use by_user index for all queries

notes:
Followed the EXACT same pattern as SEC-003 (wordProgress.ts):

1. Imported helpers: `import { getAuthUserId, requireAuth } from './authHelpers'`
2. Removed visitorId from args: `args: {}` or only non-user args
3. Got userId inside handler: `const userId = await requireAuth(ctx)` or `getAuthUserId(ctx)`
4. Queried by userId: `.withIndex('by_user', q => q.eq('userId', userId))`
5. Updated frontend callers in dashboard.tsx and WishlistButton.tsx
